messages.content:
Write formative feedback for a student from the assessor's marking. Address the student as "you".
Be specific, supportive and actionable: cite their sections/figures, name what they did well, and state what the next rubric level requires.
Do not change marks. Do not comment on document-conversion artefacts. Do not make up explanations for reasoning given by the marking agent, that is unclear or incomplete.
Schema: {"summary":str(<=80 words),"next_steps":[str,str,str],"criteria":{"<criterion id>":str(<=70 words)}}
Reply with one JSON object only. No prose, no markdown.

TASK:{"title":"Engineering Ethics Case Report: To Ship or Not to Ship","overview":"Individual written report analysing an engineering ethics case inspired by real-world professional scenarios. Students identify and discuss ethical issues, explore stakeholder decision-making, present evidence-based arguments for and against, and conclude with a justified recommended course of action. The selected scenario concerns Rachel, a QA engineer deciding whether to ship potentially defective servers, including a government health department contract."}
